tasks.title: The snapshot offers each open row's launches
tasks.summary: Each open registry row in ws snapshot gains launches: run, coordinate, close and abandon, each with its prompt, abandon asking for a reason; closed rows get none.
acceptance: tests/test_snapshot.py shows an active, a paused and a planned row each get four launches in the order run, coordinate, close, abandon, and done and abandoned rows get []
abandon's launch has ask "reason" and a prompt ending in ": "; the other three prompts equal promptText's in src/workstream/assets/web/logic.js, held by a test that reads that file
tests/test_schema.py validates a snapshot with launches against schema/snapshot.schema.json, and the schema rejects an unknown launch kind

tasks.title: The plugin's Gradle project, CLI class and test harness
tasks.summary: ui/jetbrains builds with Gradle against platform 262, loads in a headless platform test that finds a sample project through ws root and reads its snapshot, and has JUnit, source and CLI-argv tests wired into make.
acceptance: make test-jetbrains runs ./gradlew test, in which a headless platform test opens a sample project built by the branch's CLI, resolves its root and loads its snapshot through the wsCommand setting, not the ws on PATH
a folder that isn't a project and a missing ws each give their one notification, and nothing else runs
make jetbrains-zip writes a zip under ui/jetbrains/build/distributions whose plugin.xml has since-build 262, depends on com.intellij.modules.platform, and has the terminal dependency optional
make verify-jetbrains runs verifyPlugin against the local IntelliJ IDEA 2026.3 and Android Studio 2026.2 and reports both compatible
tests/test_jetbrains_files.py finds no project or agent literal and no unescaped markup sink in ui/jetbrains/src, and shows the real CLI accepts each argv Cli.kt builds
git status after a build shows nothing under ui/jetbrains/build, .gradle or .intellijPlatform
tasks.notes: The first build downloads the 262 platform into ~/.gradle; later worktrees reuse it.

tasks.title: Registry, documents, status bar and live refresh
tasks.summary: The Workstreams tool window's Registry tab draws workstreams, wave lines, phases, tasks and Documents from the snapshot, a status bar widget shows the active workstream, and outside changes reload it on their own.
acceptance: JUnit tests for the logic ports (waveLine, badgesOf, lanes, splitRows) pass with the same cases as ui/vscode/test/logic
a headless platform test shows the Registry tree's nodes for a sample project, Show done adding a closed workstream, and a Documents node opening the plan in the editor
a platform test shows a commit made outside the IDE under a refresh path reloads the snapshot once per burst
a title holding x is drawn and tooltipped as text, shown by a test and by test_jetbrains_files.py's sink scan

tasks.title: Writes through ws act, and launching in the Terminal
tasks.summary: Pause, Resume, Sync and Unclaim show only where the snapshot offers them and go through a confirm with pinned revisions; Run, Coordinate, Close and Abandon come from the row's launches and start the agent in a Terminal tab, or copy the prompt.
acceptance: a platform test confirms a pause and sees the ws act commit, and confirms a pause after an outside registry change and sees the refusal shown with HEAD unchanged
actions are disabled on nodes whose row or finding doesn't offer them, shown by a test

a test shows Run builds the Terminal argv as agentCommand plus the row's launch prompt, Abandon appends the reason, and with no agentCommand the prompt goes to the clipboard with a message naming the setting
test_jetbrains_files.py shows no Kotlin file holds a prompt text, and only Cli.kt and Launch.kt start processes

tasks.title: The review queue and diffs in the diff viewer
tasks.summary: The Review tab shows the queue, branch work first, and each task's range, gates, acceptance with proof, evidence and files; a file opens in the platform diff viewer with both sides from ws review --show.
acceptance: JUnit tests for gateSummary and rangeLine pass with ui/vscode's cases
a platform test on a branch task after main moved builds a diff request whose old side is the --show merge-base text and whose titles carry each side's rev
a binary file opens no diff and says so; a branch task's evidence opens read-only and a landed task's opens as its file, shown by tests

tasks.title: Health, notifications and the budget
tasks.summary: The Health tab lists findings with their actions, a new error finding raises one notification per session, and the Budget tab shows ws audit context when first selected and on Refresh.
acceptance: a platform test shows a stale claim listed with Unclaim, and that Unclaim going through the same confirm lands
a test shows a new error finding notifies once and a reload with the same finding doesn't notify again, with the notification body escaped
a test shows Budget runs ws audit context --json on first selection and on Refresh, and not on a file-change reload

tasks.title: Prove it in IntelliJ and Android Studio, and write down what's true
tasks.summary: The built zip installed in IntelliJ IDEA 2026.3 and Android Studio 2026.2, every tab and write checked by hand on a sample project and read-only on this repo, then the guide, the decision record and the plan's status.
acceptance: evidence records make jetbrains-zip, make verify-jetbrains reporting both IDEs compatible, and the plugin installed from disk and loaded in IntelliJ IDEA 2026.3 and Android Studio 2026.2

evidence records, in IntelliJ on a sample project built from an installed wheel: every tab and the status bar drawn, a pause landing, a stale pause refused with HEAD unchanged, a branch diff after main moved, a notified finding's unclaim, and Run in a Terminal tab
evidence records Android Studio drawing the tool window on the sample and one write landing
evidence records this repo viewed in IntelliJ with HEAD, status and refs unchanged afterwards

acceptance.text: The owner sees the plugin drawn in IntelliJ and in Android Studio

acceptance: docs/decisions/0018-jetbrains-plugin.md has what was shown and what is not proven, docs/plan.md's M10 status row links it, and README.md names the plugin

inScope: make test-jetbrains, make jetbrains-zip and make verify-jetbrains
outOfScope: chat or AI Assistant as a launch target
moving the web UI, the pane or the VS Code extension onto launches
untrusted projects, remote development and Gateway
scope.rule: Every fact and every write comes from the ws CLI; the plugin arranges what it returns, shows repo text as text, and asks before act.
